response.text:
I can do that, but I won’t cancel anything until you confirm exact details. Quick checklist — please answer the items you can so I can proceed safely:

1. Trigger: do you want me to act automatically if the client signs the SOW today, or do you want to confirm with you before I take action?
2. Which event/series exactly? Give the calendar event title (e.g., “Friday Standup”), organizer name/email, regular start time, and timezone — or paste the event ID/URL if you have it.
3. Scope: cancel just the next Friday occurrence, cancel all future occurrences of the series, or delete the entire series including past entries? (Recommended: “cancel all future occurrences”.)
4. Effective date: from which date should cancellations start (e.g., this coming Friday, next week)?
5. Notification: how should the team be informed?
   - Send a calendar cancellation update to all invited attendees (recommended)
   - Send an email instead
   - Post a Slack message (specify channel)
   - Combination of the above
6. Message text and tone: paste the exact message you want sent, or tell me tone (short/friendly/firm) and I can draft it for approval.
7. Sender: should the cancellation come from the meeting organizer (recommended) or from you/another address?
8. Any attendees who should be excluded from the notification or special instructions?

Once you reply with these details (and confirm you authorize the cancellation/notification), I’ll proceed.
